items.q: And everyone who had trouble -- like, it seems that Red Grange, the football player, was over there bothering people of color and they'd go and get Gene and Gene would go over and speak to Mr. Grange

ctx.x: And then, in World War I, it seemed like he became an ace -- his name is Gene, Eugene Jacques Bullard. And he became an ace, he was bugging the Germans and they was looking for him in the Second World War and so Gene was a very good friend -- well, he used to like me.

And everyone who had trouble -- like, it seems that Red Grange, the football player, was over there bothering people of color and they'd go and get Gene and Gene would go over and speak to Mr. Grange -- Gene, he didn't weight but about 160 lbs. but he did all types of fighting.
So, seemed like they rumbled for hours but Gene picked up a table and tore the man's skull up so that was all. Red Grange -- but, now here's two things that I saw happen to Gene.
